Stockroom

A browser inventory tool with product records, stock history and downloadable backups. No account or cloud connection.

Saved records stay on this browser and device. They are not encrypted or synced. Avoid shared devices and sensitive personal information. Clearing browser data can remove them; keep a downloaded backup.

    Backups and exports

    JSON backups can restore a workspace. CSV files are for spreadsheets and cannot be restored here. Exports contain your records; store and share them carefully.

    Browser edition 1.0 · One active workspace tab · Up to 1,000 products and 10,000 movements, within a 2 MB backup.

    What this edition does.

    • Search products and check low stock
    • Add and edit product details
    • Record dated stock receipts and issues
    • Save records in this browser and download backups
    • Export products and movement history for spreadsheets

    Know its limits.

    • One browser and one active workspace tab
    • No cloud sync, accounts or encrypted storage
    • Clearing browser data may remove saved records
    • Not a replacement for accounting, multi-user controls or managed backups
